description: Réservoirs biologiques is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. In accordance with Article R.214-108 of the Environmental Code, biological reservoirs correspond to watercourses, parts of watercourses or canals ‘which include one or more areas of reproduction or habitat of phytoplankton, macrophyte and phytobenthos species, invertebrate benthic fauna or ichthyofauna, and allow their distribution in one or more watercourses in the catchment area’. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Biological reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
